preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 65000.

preconditions.expression: all('1' <= char <= '9' for char in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s is a digit between '1' and '9'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for l in range(len(s)) for r in range(l, len(s)) if int(s[l:r+1]) % 2 == 0)
postconditions.description: The number of even substrings is the count of all substrings s[l:r+1] where the integer value of the substring is even.
